svg.title: Judgment calls demanded of one human as parallel agents grow, by supervision style
svg.desc: A line chart. Approving every agent step demands about 200 judgment calls per agent per hour and crosses a human's sustainable rate of about 100 per hour at half of one agent. Reviewing outcomes only demands about 4 calls per agent-hour and stays under the human capacity line even at ten parallel agents.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
